baseline_models.focus_anchor: The conditional sequence joins the wolf's eating, the brothers' being an usbah, and their consequent loss.
baseline_models.mechanism: Predatory consumption tests the capacity of a mutually supporting group; if the ward is removed while that capacity is present, the deficit belongs to the group itself.

activation_trace.role: The prey prepared for eating supplies literal consumption and makes Yusuf the ward whose removal tests custody.
The predatory wolf supplies the external attacker against which collective protection is asserted.
The mutually surrounding and supporting group supplies the brothers' claimed protective capacity.
General diminution makes the consequence a deficit in the group, not only harm to Yusuf.

changed_reading.before: The brothers simply boast that a wolf could not overcome so many men.
changed_reading.after: They state a conditional warranty: if their ward is consumed while their collective capacity is present, that capacity is exposed as deficient.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Qalu introduces an emphatic conditional reply that ends by classifying the speakers as losers.
baseline_models.mechanism: The reply works as a negotiated assurance with a built-in standard of measurement: occurrence of the stated loss would judge their performance as falling short.

activation_trace.role: Speech as negotiation makes the reply an assurance offered within the dispute over taking Yusuf.
Collective mutual support supplies the capacity the speakers place behind their assurance.
Short measure supplies the criterion by which their promised protection would be judged deficient.

changed_reading.before: The line predicts an unlikely bad outcome.
changed_reading.after: The line also pronounces in advance the judgment that should attach to the speakers if their assurance proves short.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The eating verb stands beside an explicitly solidaristic human group.
baseline_models.mechanism: A branch of eating names corruption stirred between people, allowing literal animal predation to cast a second, social shadow: a band may be consumed by the discord operating within it.

activation_trace.role: Eating as corruption between people supplies an intra-group analogue to the overt predatory event.
The literal predator remains the overt agent against which the social analogue is projected.
The mutually supporting band supplies the human relation vulnerable to internal corruption.

changed_reading.before: Only an outside animal threatens Yusuf and the group.
changed_reading.after: The animal threat coexists with a latent social predation in which discord within the band consumes its own protective relation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The father supplies the precise predator scenario and locates its enabling condition in the brothers' inattention. Their reply repeats the scenario but replaces that fault condition with their collective identity, turning the focus into a rebuttal of an already specified failure mode.

activation_trace.role: Anticipatory fear supplies the adverse scenario to which the focus directly responds.
The prey image supplies the same threatened consumption that the brothers take up in their reply.
The father's predatory wolf is the exact external agent repeated by the brothers.
Inattention outside vigilance supplies the father's proposed opening through which predation could occur.
Mutual surrounding support replaces inattention as the brothers' characterization of the same scene.

structural_cues: 12:13 and 12:14 are adjacent turns in one exchange.
The eating-wolf clause is repeated while 'you are inattentive' is answered by 'we are a band.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the exact repetition and the changed circumstantial clause; I infer a fault-condition substitution, while a sincere reassurance rather than a strategic rebuttal remains live.

changed_reading.before: The brothers independently offer a general boast about their strength.
changed_reading.after: They appropriate the father's own feared mechanism and deny its enabling condition by substituting collective solidarity for inattention.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same band identity first voices resentment over unequal love and sits within a sequence of plotting and proposed killing; when reused as a credential of protection, the coalition is simultaneously the alleged shield and the already disclosed danger.

activation_trace.role: Deceptive plotting supplies the anticipated mode by which the sibling relation may turn hostile.
Kinship supplies the relation within which the coalition compares itself with Yusuf and his brother.
Love attached to the heart supplies the contested good around which the coalition's grievance forms.
The mutually supporting band first identifies itself inside a complaint, loading the later protective claim with prior rivalry.
The proposal to end life makes the coalition a concrete source of danger rather than a neutral group.
The repeated band image is redeployed as the very guarantee of Yusuf's safety.

structural_cues: The identical usbah expression occurs in 12:8 and 12:14.
The grievance and removal proposal precede the request for custody and the focus reply.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated group language, jealousy, plotting, and a killing proposal; I infer that the protective credential is contaminated by its prior hostile use, while the brothers may still imagine their solidarity as genuinely protective.

changed_reading.before: Their numbers make an external wolf attack implausible.
changed_reading.after: Their numbers are double-edged: the coalition invoked as protection has already organized the internal threat from which Yusuf needs protection.

context_deltas.mechanism: A challenge about trust, a profession of counsel free from fraud, and an explicit promise to guard Yusuf precede the focus. The loss clause therefore underwrites custody the brothers actively solicit, rather than merely describing group pride.

activation_trace.role: Secure trust supplies the disputed relational condition the brothers ask the father to grant.
Purity from fraud supplies the quality the brothers claim for their proposed care.
Active guarding supplies the explicit performance promised before the focus conditional.
Short measure turns failure of the promised guard into measurable underperformance.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from requested trust to claimed sincerity to promised guarding to the consequence of failed guarding.
Repeated emphatic constructions bind the assurances into one persuasive exchange.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies solicitation, trust, sincerity, and guarding language; I infer a custody-like performance bond, while a less formal sequence of rhetorical reassurance remains possible.

changed_reading.before: Loss would merely embarrass a strong group.
changed_reading.after: Loss would breach the specific custody assurance by which the group obtained permission to take Yusuf.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after the focus, collective resolve places Yusuf in a hidden depression and receiving cavity. The band's cohesion does not fail to prevent disappearance; it supplies the coordinated agency that produces disappearance.

activation_trace.role: Mutual surrounding support supplies the collective capacity whose causal direction is reversed.
Resolved gathering of opinion supplies coordinated intention rather than accidental failure.
A depression in which something vanishes supplies the spatial mechanism of concealment.
A cavity that receives something supplies the destination created for the group's removal act.

structural_cues: The focus claim is followed immediately by the brothers' collective resolve and placement of Yusuf.
The grammatical group remains the agent while the predicted external predator never enters the action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies collective resolve and a concealed receiving space; I infer a causal reversal from protection despite cohesion to removal by means of cohesion, while usbah can still retain its surface force as a boast about numbers.

changed_reading.before: A strong band makes Yusuf's disappearance despite them nearly impossible.
changed_reading.after: The strong band is precisely what makes coordinated disappearance possible: he is lost not despite their cohesion but through it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later report repeats the focus's eating-wolf proposition after performed grief and an account of racing and leaving Yusuf. It anticipates disbelief and is followed by false material evidence, so the earlier conditional becomes a ready-made script for transferring agency to an external predator.

activation_trace.role: Speech that attributes what did not occur supplies the latent alibi potential of the focus reply.
Assumed crying supplies a performed affective frame for the later report.
False attribution supplies the report that assigns the disappearance to the wolf.
Racing ahead supplies the distraction episode used to explain absence from Yusuf.
Leaving something behind supplies the claimed lapse that makes the predator story narratively possible.
The repeated prey-consumption image realizes the exact antecedent first voiced in the focus.
The repeated external predator receives the agency displaced from the brothers.
Belief that settles the heart supplies the reception the speakers seek while anticipating its refusal.
Truthful speech supplies the explicitly contested status of their account.
Contradiction of truth identifies the supporting blood evidence as false and closes the alibi mechanism.

structural_cues: The compact eating-wolf clause in 12:14 recurs in the brothers' report in 12:17.
The report is framed by crying before it and false blood evidence after it.
The narrated lapse answers the father's earlier inattention scenario.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact verbal recurrence, performed grief, an explanatory lapse, anticipated disbelief, and false evidence; I infer that the focus precomposes an alibi, while the later wording could instead be an opportunistic reuse remembered only at report time.

changed_reading.before: The conditional denies that the father's feared event could happen.
changed_reading.after: The denial also rehearses the proposition later asserted as an alibi, planting both the external agent and the standard excuse before the disappearance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus branch of short measure joins the prior guarding promise to a shirt made to bear false blood and to the account the father calls a description. Loss becomes not bad luck but deficient performance covered by counterfeit material proof.

activation_trace.role: Giving short measure supplies a material and ethical model for failing the promised quantity of care.
Guarding supplies the service whose delivered measure is later exposed as deficient.
The worn shirt supplies the material carrier offered as proof of predation.
Blood-red coloration supplies the visible mark meant to certify the claimed consumption.
A garment that lies by its condition makes the evidence itself perform the deceptive shortage.
Rendering a thing by its asserted qualities supplies the verbal account paired with the counterfeit display.

structural_cues: The guarding promise precedes the focus's loss judgment.
The later report couples a verbal description with a materially displayed shirt and blood.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies short-measure imagery, promised guarding, and false material description; I infer an accounting arrow from deficient custody to fraudulent proof, while khusr may remain only a general term for disgrace.

changed_reading.before: Khasirun means that the brothers would be unfortunate or disgraced.
changed_reading.after: Khasirun also judges them as custodians who short the promised measure and then counterfeit the account of delivery.

context_deltas.mechanism: Plotting within kinship over concentrated paternal love activates the social-corruption branch of eating. The overt wolf can then function as a projection screen for the predation already taking place among the brothers.

activation_trace.role: Corruption stirred between people supplies the social mechanism beneath the literal eating claim.
The overt wolf supplies the external predator onto which internal hostility can be displaced.
Deceptive plotting supplies the active form taken by corruption within the sibling group.
Brotherhood supplies the social body in which the corrosive eating operates.
Heart-bound love supplies the scarce relational good whose unequal distribution triggers the corrosion.

structural_cues: The jealousy complaint and plotting occur before the wolf exchange.
The external predator is named by the speakers whose internal conflict has already targeted Yusuf.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies kinship, unequal love, plotting, and the social-corruption branch of eating; I infer projection from internal predation to an external wolf, while literal predation remains the primary surface sense.

changed_reading.before: The wolf is the sole imagined consumer of Yusuf.
changed_reading.after: The wolf story externalizes a prior social consumption: jealous plotting is already eating through brotherhood before any animal is named.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a specialized animal-care image rather than the ordinary predator sense. It remains anchored in the focus wolf and in the later father, shirt, red blood, and lying display: a wolf simulation is used to induce parental acceptance of a substituted account for a missing child. Render it only as an exploratory structural analogy, not as a lexical translation of wolf.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus names the wolf that the later bloodied-shirt display impersonates.

activation_trace.role: Disguising something as a wolf to induce a mother to accept a substitute supplies the startling parental-deception template.
Fatherhood and nurture supply the parental recipient whom the simulated predator story is meant to persuade.
The shirt supplies the costume-like material surface on which predation is simulated.
Blood redness supplies the visual resemblance by which the wolf story is dressed as an event.
The garment that lies by its condition supplies the false appearance intended to secure parental acceptance.

changed_reading.before: The wolf is only the literal animal proposed as a possible cause.
changed_reading.after: The wolf also becomes a disguise: its visible traces are simulated so a father will accept a substitute story in place of his absent son.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain spatial reading from saddle anatomy and bodily binding to group structure. It remains anchored in the focus wolf and usbah and is activated by the actual hidden cavity in 12:15. Render it as an analogy about a blind spot within cohesion, not as a claim that the focus nouns directly denote the well.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The wolf and the tightly bound group stand together in the focus conditional.

activation_trace.role: The gap beneath joined saddle arches supplies a vulnerable opening internal to an apparently enclosing structure.
Tendons binding joints supply the image of the brothers as one tightly connected corporate body.
A depression that hides what enters it realizes the latent opening as a concealment site.
The receiving cavity gives concrete spatial form to the opening produced within the collective action.

changed_reading.before: An outside predator would have to overpower a solid group.
changed_reading.after: The bound group contains or creates its own opening, and Yusuf disappears through the blind spot generated by the formation itself.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading depends on the non-dominant q-l-l mapping under the focus speech root, so it is deliberately form-distant. It remains anchored by the utterance's direct opposition between a numerous band and consequent diminution. Render it as a mapped-root shadow on the boast, not as the ordinary lexical sense of qalu.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The speakers assert collective abundance while naming the condition under which they become diminished.

activation_trace.role: Smallness and paucity supply a latent counterweight inside the utterance that boasts of numbers.
The supporting group supplies the apparent abundance exposed to collapse.
General diminution supplies the result in which the many prove functionally little.

changed_reading.before: Qalu merely introduces a boast by a numerous coalition.
changed_reading.after: The boast carries a mapped-root shadow of paucity: if one vulnerable member can be lost, the self-proclaimed many are exposed as functionally little.

strongest_changes: The focus repeats the father's exact predator scenario but substitutes collective solidarity for his accusation of inattention.
The same usbah that first organized jealous grievance becomes the claimed credential of protection and then the coordinated means of disappearance.
The conditional eating-wolf clause is later reused as an alibi framed by performed grief and false material evidence.
Khasirun shifts from generic disgrace toward self-pronounced liability for short custody and counterfeit accounting.
summary.what_was_special: The trace is driven by reversals rather than one disambiguation: shield becomes threat, cohesion becomes causal agency, prediction becomes script, and literal predation coexists with social consumption. The wolf-disguise and internal-gap branches preserve packet-specific surprise without replacing the surface reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The custody-warranty and short-measure readings are functional inferences, not explicit legal formulations.
The social-eating model may be a strong structural analogy rather than an activated lexical sense in this occurrence.
The wolf-disguise, saddle-gap, and q-l-l readings should remain marked as exploratory mapped-branch effects.
